name: angeloyal-operations-management

scripts.deploy:dev: npm run use:dev && clasp push && clasp deploy -i AKfycbziNYgamxGPl7B8OVB1YYb1bZ2VZEdb9RC59pTEtUzSOeVNxAZCVtMc-6jJrqmdk26XgQ && npm run deploy:web:dev
scripts.release: npm run use:prod && clasp push --force && clasp deploy -i AKfycby8gSa29N58Ny3mJjkDgdbnaIWUfQocPQwJ0QochAh_mLDsmYslJaO0ANDCbuXYNYV0 && npm run deploy:web

scriptsHelp.test: run the local test suite (no clasp, no live Sheet)
scriptsHelp.login: authenticate clasp with your Google account (one-time)
scriptsHelp.use:dev | use:prod: point .clasp.json at the DEV/PROD script (done automatically by the commands below)
scriptsHelp.pull: pull source from the PROD script editor (overwrites local files!)
scriptsHelp.push: push source to the DEV script editor/HEAD (never touches prod)
scriptsHelp.watch: like push, but re-pushes on every file save
scriptsHelp.dev:web: serve web/ locally on :8788 with _headers applied, against the DEV backend
scriptsHelp.open | open:prod: open the DEV/PROD script in the Apps Script editor
scriptsHelp.deploy:dev: push backend to DEV + deploy web/ to angeloyal-oms-dev.pages.dev
scriptsHelp.deploy:web | deploy:web:dev: deploy web/ alone to the PROD/DEV Pages project (no backend push)
scriptsHelp.release: push backend to PROD + deploy web/ to angeloyal-oms.pages.dev — only from main, after tagging
scriptsHelp.deployments: list deployments of the currently selected script
scriptsHelp.logs: tail Apps Script logs of the currently selected script
scriptsHelp.fetch-data: snapshot PROD sheets to data/ (gitignored); add -- --dev for the DEV sheet
scriptsHelp.clear-data: DEV: wipe transactional sheets (Trips, Outlets, waybills, logs)
scriptsHelp.clear-data:prod: PROD: same wipe, asks you to type PRODUCTION — post-release only
scriptsHelp.changelog:sync: regenerate web/changelog.json from GitHub Releases (add -- --apply to write)
scriptsHelp.backlog:seed: seed GitHub issues from the backlog doc
scriptsHelp.backlog:sync: regenerate BACKLOG.md from the GitHub Project board
